Winding Up Subject To The Supervision
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who is appointed by the company or the court to wind up the affairs of a company and to distribute its assets, if any among creditors and contributors in accordance with the articles."

Provisional liquidator A liquidator is a person who is appointed by the company or the court to wind up the affairs of a company and to distribute its assets, if any among creditors and contributors in accordance with the articles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the body charged with the responsibility of administering the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2004."
The Corporate Affairs Commission is the body charged with the responsibility of administering the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2004.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an artificial person who needs to run its affairs through other means or instruments."
The company is an artificial person who needs to run its affairs through other means or instruments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the amount contributed by the company's shareholders to the company's resources."
The share capital is the amount contributed by the company's shareholders to the company's resources.
fib: ______ refers to various types of agreements which a proposed company enters into before its eventual registration.
Pre-incorporation contract refers to various types of agreements which a proposed company enters into before its eventual registration.
______ are an agreement entered into before a company is formed.
Pre-incorporation contracts are an agreement entered into before a company is formed.
______ is the relation which subsists between two or more persons carrying on business in common with a view of profits.
A partnership is the relation which subsists between two or more persons carrying on business in common with a view of profits.
______ is a law passed by the National Assembly and signed by the President.
An Act is a law passed by the National Assembly and signed by the President.
